title: Python UDF concurrency documentation update
summary: Updated documentation for Python UDF concurrency settings in ExternalRuntimeOptions, adding links to configuration guides.
details: The description for `containerRequestConcurrency` within `ExternalRuntimeOptions` has been updated to provide a direct link to the official documentation for configuring container limits for Python UDFs. The wording was also slightly refined to refer to 'Python UDF instances' rather than 'container instances'.
